entry: WHEN close-run refuses only its judgement stage (reason over the length cap) DO issue the `judgement` verb alone with a shorter reason — the earlier stages have landed and run-end refuses a second close-run.
why: displaces the status-Done-before-merge note, settled doctrine now; the judgement cap bit twice this feature

entry: WHEN opening a run for a single task DO read the executing persona's squad in team-config.yaml before run-start — documentor is product, not eng; a run opened against the wrong lead closes BLOCKED at zero cycles and leaves a dead run record.
why: t02 opened against eng-lead by reflex and had to be closed BLOCKED
